notes:
Summary: Lacuna is a mid-market SaaS helpdesk vendor (ticketing + knowledge base) evaluating Redwood for a retrieval-augmented customer support agent and ticket-deflection layer. Primary champion: Head of Search, Priyanka Rao (Dir. Product). Budget scoped to dedicated capacity + security add-on.

Key requirements / asks (from eval call 2026-02-14):
- Production index targets: ~25M ticket records + ~8M KB passages (initial), want architecture that scales to 100M+ passages within 12 months.
- Latency SLOs: p95 end-to-end conversational/agent path <= 300ms for token streaming; reranker round-trip (embedding + similarity + top-5 rerank) p95 <= 180ms. Emphasis on top-5 precision / MRR.
- Cost sensitivity: target amortized cost-per-query (RAG search + rerank) <= $0.004/query at current volume (500k queries/month), want optimizer recommendations.
- Model preferences: open LLM variants for on-prem (quantized) with a hosted fallback for spikes; considering Llama2/3 and Mistral-like families.
- Routing/fallback: require policy to fallback to lower-cost model variant when Dedicated pool saturated; preserve answer quality for top-5 re-rank.
- Security/compliance: SSO (SAML), strict audit logs, KMS integrations, and EU data residency for EMEA customers.

POC progress / timeline:
- 2026-02-01: Intro call (AE: Maya) — requirement capture.
- 2026-02-08: SE scoping call (Daniel) — agreed on dataset sample (100k tickets + 250k KB passages) for baseline.
- 2026-02-14: POC kickoff (Fireflies id ff_20260214_lacuna_poc_call).
- 2026-02-21: Ingest pass completed for sample dataset; embeddings pipeline validated (quantized encoder tested).
- 2026-02-28: Initial rerank model test — Redwood candidate reranker increased top-5 precision by ~12% vs Lucene BM25 baseline (internal metric).
- 2026-03-04: Perf anomaly flagged during high-concurrency test (p95 rerank spiked to 420ms) — ticket RDW-1123 opened.
- 2026-03-05: Joint post-mortem and tuning plan; Redwood SE suggested batching and KV cache changes.

Customer quotes / call highlights:
- "Top-5 quality is everything — we can tolerate a slightly slower tail but not worse answers in the top results." — Priyanka Rao, Head of Search.
- "If you can't give us a clear unit cost and predictable p95, we can't commit to Dedicated capacity." — VP Ops (procurement).

Technical notes / constraints:
- Must maintain per-tenant data isolation for embeddings index and per-route tracing for audits.
- Strong preference for quantized local models to meet cost targets; will accept hosted API as spike capacity only.
- Reranker must be compatible with token-budgeted LLMs and support accelerated kernels for short sequences.

Next actions (short):
- Redwood: run tuned perf sweep with continuous-batching + KV caching for rerank path (due 2026-03-12).
- Customer: finalize security questionnaire answers and share internal SOC2 report (due 2026-03-11).
- Joint: schedule canary test with 50k q/day for 7 days (tentative 2026-03-20).

Notes on commercials: Pricing sensitivity around committed throughput vs burst capacity. Priyanka prefers monthly reserved GPU slots with auto-burst to hosted. Procurement requested example SLO language for p95 and rollback clauses.
